welcome.intro: Your account is free, and Sensei Top works the same without it. It can do three things, each only if you say yes. Nothing is chosen for you, and you can change each answer later under Account in Settings.
welcome.stored: Your account itself (the email address, name and picture Google or Discord shared, and your answers here) is kept at Supabase, in São Paulo, Brazil.
welcome.kept: Your earlier answers are shown below and keep applying until you press Continue. You can change any of them here, or later under Account in Settings.

age.label: I'm 13 or older. If I'm under 18, a parent or guardian has said I can have an account and, if I choose to, send my games.
age.small: We store that you confirmed this, and when.

sync.title: Back up my match history
sync.what: A summary of each match is uploaded: when it was played, the format, your deck, the result and the opponent's cards you saw. It survives a reinstall and reaches your other PCs.
sync.where: It's kept at Supabase, in São Paulo, Brazil, until you delete it or your account. Your Arena and MTGO logs, names and chat are never uploaded.

errors.title: Send error reports
errors.what: When something goes wrong, the app sends a report to Sentry, in the United States. It holds the error, where in the code it happened, the app version and your system.
errors.linked: It's linked to your account by an internal ID, never by your email. Names, keys and file paths are removed before it's sent, and it's kept for 30 days.
errors.either: Either way, Report a problem sends one report each time you press it.

transfer.title: Sending error reports to the United States
transfer.law: Sentry stores error reports in the United States, so they leave Brazil. The United States has no data-protection law like Brazil's LGPD. Authorities there may be able to reach the reports under US law, and your rights may be harder to enforce there.
transfer.ip: Sentry doesn't store your IP address, but works out an approximate location from it first.
transfer.agree: I agree that my error reports are sent to Sentry, in the United States.
transfer.withdraw: If you don't agree, nothing is sent automatically. You can withdraw this at any time by turning error reports off.

coach.title: Keep my coach history
coach.kept: The rules coach comes in a later version. With this on, your questions and its answers are saved at Supabase, in Brazil, so you can reread them. They stay until you delete them or your account.
coach.off: With it off, neither is kept. Only when you asked, which model answered and what it cost is kept, for 90 days.

policy.lead: What is stored, where and for how long:

contribute.title: Help build the stats
contribute.storedNo: You said no to this on {{date}}. You can keep that answer or change it here.
contribute.apart: This isn't one of your account's choices. It works the same with or without an account, and your answer stays on this PC.
contribute.what: Saying yes sends your games to a private pool that Sensei Top's own stats are built from. That means the games already in your history and the ones you play from now on. Before a game leaves this PC, everything that names you or your opponent is removed, and it's sent without your sign-in.
contribute.pool: The pool is kept in Brazil, with no link to any account.
contribute.final: Nothing in a sent game says who sent it. Once it's sent, it can't be shown to you, copied or deleted, not even by deleting your account.
contribute.off: You can turn it off at any time in Settings, and nothing more is sent after that.

hint.answers: Confirm your age and answer each question to continue.
hint.transfer: To send error reports, agree to sending them to the United States, or choose Don't send.

welcome.declineNote: Deletes the account this sign-in just made, with what Google or Discord shared, and signs you out. Sensei Top works the same without one.

error.failed: Your answers were not saved, and nothing was changed. Try again.
error.declineFailed: The account was not deleted, and nothing was changed. Try again.
error.signOutFailed: You were not signed out. Try again.

settings.title: Account
settings.unavailable: This version of Sensei Top has no account.
settings.signedOut: An account is free and optional. Sensei Top works the same without one. With one, you can back up your match history, move it to another PC, and choose whether to send error reports.
settings.noPassword: There's no Sensei Top password: you sign in with Google or Discord.
settings.waiting: Finish signing in in your browser. Sensei Top waits up to 5 minutes.
settings.waitingAgain: Pressing a sign-in button again starts over.
settings.unanswered: You haven't answered your account's questions yet. Until you do, nothing is backed up or sent as an error report.
settings.unknown: Your choices couldn't be read from your account. Sensei Top tries again at the next backup.

backup.label: Back up my match history
backup.description: Uploads a summary of each match, so your history survives a reinstall and reaches your other PCs. Kept in Brazil until you delete it.

errors.label: Send error reports
errors.description: Sends a report to Sentry, in the United States, when something goes wrong. Kept for 30 days. Report a problem works either way.

coach.label: Keep my coach history
coach.description: Saves your questions to the rules coach and its answers so you can reread them. The coach comes in a later version.

settings.turningOff: Turning a choice off stops it from then on. To remove what was already uploaded, use Delete cloud history.

sync.off: Backup is off. Your match history stays only on this PC.
sync.done_one: {{n}} match backed up from this PC. Last backup {{when}}.
sync.done_other: {{n}} matches backed up from this PC. Last backup {{when}}.
sync.doneUndated_one: {{n}} match backed up from this PC.
sync.doneUndated_other: {{n}} matches backed up from this PC.

error.cloud: The last backup stopped because your account couldn't be reached. Sensei Top tries again when the next match ends.
error.localApi: The last backup stopped because Sensei Top couldn't read the matches on this PC. It tries again when the next match ends.
error.disk: The last backup stopped because Sensei Top couldn't save its backup record on this PC. It tries again when the next match ends.

export.description: Saves everything in your account as one JSON file, wherever you choose.
export.failed: The export didn't finish. Try again.

history.description: Deletes the matches backed up to your account and turns backup off. The matches on this PC stay.
history.done_one: {{n}} match deleted from your cloud history. Backup is off.
history.done_other: {{n}} matches deleted from your cloud history. Backup is off.
history.removed: They're removed for good after 30 days, once your other PCs have caught up.

deleteAccount.description: Deletes your account and everything in it. The matches on this PC stay.

signOut.description: Backup stops on this PC until you sign in again. Your matches stay.

persistence.noKeyring: This system has no keyring, so Sensei Top doesn't keep your sign-in, and you'll sign in again each time you open the app. Backup runs only while you're signed in.
persistence.keyringHint: With a keyring set up (such as GNOME Keyring or KWallet), the app keeps your sign-in, encrypted.
persistence.noEncryption: This system can't encrypt your sign-in, so Sensei Top doesn't keep it, and you'll sign in again each time you open the app. Backup runs only while you're signed in.

deleteHistory.title: Delete your cloud history?
deleteHistory.body1: This deletes every match backed up to your account. The matches on this PC stay where they are.
deleteHistory.body2: Backup also turns off, so nothing is uploaded again until you turn it back on. If you do, every match on this PC is uploaded again.

failed.historyOn: Your cloud history wasn't deleted, and nothing has changed. Try again.
failed.historyOff: Your cloud history wasn't deleted. Backup is off, so nothing more is uploaded. Try again.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.body1: This deletes your Sensei Top account and everything in it: your profile and choices, the PCs linked to it, and every match backed up to it. It leaves our database at once.
deleteAccount.body2: The matches on this PC stay where they are. So do the games you sent to Help build the stats: nothing in them says they're yours, so they can't be found to delete. Error reports already sent stay at Sentry until they're deleted, 30 days after they were sent.
deleteAccount.body3: You'll be signed out on this PC. Help build the stats stays as you set it, since it needs no account.
deleteAccount.failed: Your account wasn't deleted, and nothing has changed. Try again.

errorsDialog.title: Send error reports to the United States?
errorsDialog.withdraw: You can withdraw this at any time by turning error reports off.
